g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anyth
ing. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create
a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a
file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name.
A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared ident
ity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-ev
al-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list
route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an e
val suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted
fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to
legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [List a su
ite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the pu
blic steps-first shape.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one
case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH
can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured mo
del is used.\n- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up
to 100 cases to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test
files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and
reported individually: a `failed`…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs
/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases aga
inst them, and persists them: the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect,
respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.
md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person
already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ord
ered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rea
d-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`,
then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite.
A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skippe
d` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-
eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that execute
d it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial u
pdate: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOp
tions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically
widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResult
s` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` a
nd `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /p
rojects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval inges
tion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discove
r authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval in
gestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and t
he same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in
one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: sub
mit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease f
or MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): Ho
w an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no pro
vider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed
project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for end
ing a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until
this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
val-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authent
icate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called
by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records
only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed us
age. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-
a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair
with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-run
s-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who c
